diagnosis: The endpoint utilizes QuerySet.extra(where=[...]) to filter CustomerInvoice by billing_account_ref provided in the query string without scoping the query to request.user.organization. An attacker can supply predictable account codes belonging to other enterprise clients and retrieve issued invoices containing billed amounts, tax identifiers, and confidential line items.
exploit_request:
GET /api/billing/invoices/export/?account_code=ACC-CORP-GLOBEX-44 HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.enterprisesaas.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_client_token>
